24.0.en: They noted a sharp [[contrast:contrast]] between the two plans, but the [[overlap:overlap]] in their friendship helped everyone.
24.0.zh: 两份计划反差明显，但友情里重合的那部分帮到了每一个人。

24.1.en: No harsh [[contradiction:contradiction]] appeared even when tired friends began to [[disagree:disagree]] softly.
24.1.zh: 即使疲惫的朋友们开始轻声表示异议，也没有出现尖锐的冲突。

24.2.en: Study habits may [[differ:differ]] widely, yet [[diverse:diverse]] voices made the group stronger.
24.2.zh: 学习习惯可以千差万别，但多元的声音让小组更强大。

24.3.en: Mei loved every subtle [[nuance:nuance]] in a voice, and every [[gentle:gentle]] game of [[inductive:inductive]] reasoning.
24.3.zh: 梅喜欢话语里细微的差别，也喜欢玩那种温和的归纳推理游戏。

24.4.en: For one clear [[instance:instance]], Sam worked through problems to [[confirm:confirm]] his [[steady:steady]] improvement.
24.4.zh: 有一回，山姆一口气做完几道题，证实了自己稳定的进步。

24.5.en: Tutors would [[demonstrate:demonstrate]] each step clearly, then [[illustrate:illustrate]] the idea with a simple example.
24.5.zh: 导师把每一步演示得清清楚楚，再用一个简单的例子说明道理。

25.0.en: Calm confidence began to [[manifest:manifest]] itself as friends vowed to [[resolve:resolve]] their old fears.
25.0.zh: 平静的自信开始显露，朋友们发誓要化解积攒已久的恐惧。

25.1.en: The club ran a short, fun [[survey:survey]] and some tiny, honest [[research:research]] into snacking habits.
25.1.zh: 社团做了一份简短有趣的小调查，还认真研究了大家的零食习惯。

25.2.en: New members paused to [[observe:observe]] the older students and politely [[inquire:inquire]] about joining steps.
25.2.zh: 新成员驻足观察学长学姐，礼貌地打听加入的步骤。

25.3.en: Each visitor left one short [[query:query]] and filled in a simple [[questionnaire:questionnaire]] with care.
25.3.zh: 每位访客留下一句简短的疑问，又认真填了一份简单的问卷。

25.4.en: Together they hoped to [[accomplish:accomplish]] their shared goals and [[attain:attain]] [[stable:stable]] final grades.
25.4.zh: 他们一起盼着实现共同的目标，在期末拿到稳稳的成绩。

25.5.en: The tall students formed a tidy [[queue:queue]], and the leaders kindly [[grant:granted]] each wish.
25.5.zh: 高个子同学排成一列整齐的队，负责人则和气地答应每个人的心愿。

26.0.en: Teachers offered warm, honest [[praise:praise]], and the students deeply [[appreciate:appreciated]] the kind support.
26.0.zh: 老师们送上温暖而真诚的表扬，学生们也深深感激这份善意。

26.1.en: Honest daily [[feedback:feedback]] kept them from ever [[underestimate:underestimating]] slow, [[steady:steady]] growth.
26.1.zh: 每天诚恳的反馈让他们不再小看那种慢而稳的成长。

26.2.en: They learned never to [[overestimate:overestimate]] raw talent, and treasured the club's warm [[fellowship:fellowship]].
26.2.zh: 他们学会不高估天赋，也把社团温暖的情谊看得珍贵。

26.3.en: At the [[lively:lively]] club fair, Mei won a small [[scholarship:scholarship]] for all her [[diligent:diligent]] evening work.
26.3.zh: 热闹的社团招新会上，梅凭着每晚的踏实用功赢得了一小笔奖学金。

26.4.en: Passing the finals felt like a sweet [[reward:reward]] after so many sleepless nights of shared work.
26.4.zh: 熬过那么多一起用功的不眠之夜，通过期末考就像一份甜甜的回报。

26.5.en: Every new member paid a tiny club [[fee:fee]] and received warm welcome gifts in return.
26.5.zh: 每位新成员交了少许社团费，也收到了暖心的欢迎礼。

27.0.en: On Monday morning, Lily told us about early [[civilisation:civilisation]] and the [[renaissance:Renaissance]] in the big hall.
27.0.zh: 周一早上，莉莉在大礼堂给我们讲了古代文明和文艺复兴。

27.1.en: Her old maps showed an [[epic:epic]] [[tale:tale]] and a new [[ideology:ideology]] from distant lands.
27.1.zh: 她的旧地图上，有来自远方的史诗故事和新的思想体系。

27.2.en: We kept each [[tradition:tradition]] alive and followed every old [[convention:convention]] with happy smiles.
27.2.zh: 我们让每一样传统保持鲜活，微笑着遵循每一项旧习俗。

27.3.en: Tom spoke of [[feudalism:feudalism]] long ago and the torment of [[slavery:slavery]] in those dark times.
27.3.zh: 汤姆讲了很久以前的封建制度，还有那个黑暗年代奴隶制的苦难。

27.4.en: Our teacher said every [[ethical:ethical]] choice needs a clear [[moral:moral]] heart.
27.4.zh: 老师说，每一个合乎伦理的选择，都需要一颗清明的道德之心。

27.5.en: A kind man from a distant [[tribe:tribe]] shared [[aboriginal:aboriginal]] songs with the children.
27.5.zh: 一位来自遥远部落的好心人，给孩子们唱起了原住民的歌谣。

28.0.en: Every [[inhabitant:inhabitant]] loves this town, and every [[local:local]] face we meet feels warm.
28.0.zh: 这里的每位居民都热爱小镇，我们遇到的每张本地面孔都让人感到亲切。

28.1.en: An [[exotic:exotic]] [[fruit:fruit]] cake amazed every [[foreigner:foreigner]] at the long table.
28.1.zh: 一款奇异水果蛋糕，让长桌旁的每位外国客人都惊叹不已。

28.2.en: No one felt [[alien:alien]], because a wise [[anthropologist:anthropologist]] welcomed everyone with tea.
28.2.zh: 有睿智的人类学家用茶款待大家，谁也不觉得自己是外人。

28.3.en: Her [[humanitarian:humanitarian]] work keeps our old [[heritage:heritage]] safe for the children.
28.3.zh: 她的人道主义工作，为孩子们守护着我们古老的文化遗产。

28.4.en: We will [[inherit:inherit]] the old songs and keep each [[antique:antique]] cup on the mantel.
28.4.zh: 我们要继承那些老歌，并把每只古董杯好好摆上壁炉架。

28.5.en: Lily loves [[archaeology:archaeology]] and helped us [[excavate:excavate]] [[clay:clay]] near the hill.
28.5.zh: 莉莉热爱考古学，还帮我们在山边挖黏土。

29.0.en: On Tuesday we visited the [[museum:museum]] halls and admired the bright [[pottery:pottery]] bowls.
29.0.zh: 周二我们参观了博物馆展厅，看那些亮闪闪的陶碗。

29.1.en: Skilled hands [[engrave:engrave]] stones, and they help us [[decorate:decorate]] jars with flowers.
29.1.zh: 巧手在石头上雕刻，还教我们用花纹装饰陶罐。

29.2.en: We learned about one [[religion:religion]] and joined a [[quiet:quiet]] morning [[ritual:ritual]] together.
29.2.zh: 我们了解了一种宗教，还一起参加了安静的晨间仪式。

29.3.en: Good [[etiquette:etiquette]] keeps each [[sacred:sacred]] room calm and bright for all friends.
29.3.zh: 得体的礼仪让每间神圣的房间，对所有朋友都保持宁静明亮。

29.4.en: The [[hallowed:hallowed]] wall and the [[holy:holy]] chime made us feel calm and glad.
29.4.zh: 受人敬仰的墙和神圣的钟声，让我们心里平静而欢喜。

29.5.en: A kind [[pope:pope]] smiled at the young [[bishop:bishop]] beside the tall door.
29.5.zh: 和善的教皇朝站在高门旁的年轻主教微笑。

30.0.en: A young [[missionary:missionary]] met the old [[priest:priest]] near the lakeside.
30.0.zh: 年轻的传教士在湖边遇见了老牧师。

30.1.en: We read from the old [[bible:Bible]] and then walked to the white [[church:church]] together.
30.1.zh: 我们一起念了念旧《圣经》，然后一同走向白色的教堂。

30.2.en: The tall [[cathedral:cathedral]] bells rang while the little [[choir:choir]] sang sweet songs.
30.2.zh: 高大的教堂钟声响起，小小的唱诗班唱着甜美的歌。

30.3.en: A [[quiet:quiet]] [[monk:monk]] showed us the old [[temple:temple]] yard full of trees.
30.3.zh: 安静的僧侣带我们看那座长满树木的古寺院子。

30.4.en: Beyond the red [[pagoda:pagoda]], we heard tales of a great [[empire:empire]] from long ago.
30.4.zh: 红塔之外，我们听着很久以前大帝国的故事。

30.5.en: The [[imperial:imperial]] gold shone through every [[tale:tale]] of a [[dynasty:dynasty]] written on the wall.
30.5.zh: 墙上一段段王朝故事里，闪着帝王的金色光辉。

31.0.en: Old [[chronology:chronology]] charts told of an [[emperor:emperor]] who was kind to children.
31.0.zh: 古老的年表上，写着一位善待孩子的皇帝。

31.1.en: A brave [[prince:prince]] smiled at the little [[princess:princess]] by the flowers.
31.1.zh: 勇敢的王子朝花丛边的小公主微笑。

31.2.en: With great [[majesty:majesty]], the old [[nobility:nobility]] arrived in long bright robes.
31.2.zh: 老贵族们身着鲜亮长袍，威仪十足地到场。

31.3.en: Our kind [[lord:lord]] thanked the brave [[knight:knight]] before the [[crowd:crowd]] of friends.
31.3.zh: 好心的勋爵当着一众朋友的面，感谢了勇敢的骑士。

31.4.en: A strong [[guardian:guardian]] served us sweet tea and spoke, with soft [[nostalgia:nostalgia]], about home.
31.4.zh: 稳重的监护人给我们端来甜茶，带着淡淡的怀旧讲起家乡。

31.5.en: Each [[homesick:homesick]] child met a kind [[celebrity:celebrity]] and smiled again.
31.5.zh: 每个想家的孩子，在遇见那位和善的名人后都重新露出笑容。

32.0.en: High [[status:status]] never stopped a warm [[anecdote:anecdote]] from making us laugh.
32.0.zh: 身份再高，也挡不住一则温暖的趣闻把大家逗笑。

32.1.en: An [[accident:accident]] delayed our outing, but no sad [[incident:incident]] ruined the day.
32.1.zh: 一场小事故耽搁了出游，但没有糟心的事件破坏这一天。

32.2.en: Small shops [[thrive:thrive]] here and bring lasting [[prosperity:prosperity]] to the town.
32.2.zh: 这里的小店生意兴隆，给小镇带来长久的繁荣。

32.3.en: Each [[setback:setback]] taught us to face [[adversity:adversity]] with calm, brave hearts.
32.3.zh: 每一次挫折都教会我们：用平静勇敢的心去面对逆境。

32.4.en: Her neat [[handwriting:handwriting]] copied each old [[pictograph:pictograph]] onto white [[paper:paper]].
32.4.zh: 她用工整的字迹，把每个古老的象形字抄到白纸上。

32.5.en: A thin [[wedge:wedge]] held the door open while children tied a red [[knot:knot]] for fun.
32.5.zh: 一片薄木楔抵着门，孩子们拴了个红绳结，玩得开心。

33.0.en: On Wednesday our word room opened with fun games about [[linguistics:linguistics]] and clear [[semantic:semantic]] puzzles.
33.0.zh: 周三，我们的“字词教室”开课了：先玩有趣的语言学游戏，再猜清楚的语义谜题。

33.1.en: With Anna, we studied the simple rules of [[syntax:syntax]] and the sweet sounds of [[phonetics:phonetics]].
33.1.zh: 我们跟着安娜学简单的句法规则，听语音学里那些好听的声音。

33.2.en: Tom helped us [[pronounce:pronounce]] new words and keep a [[smooth:smooth]] [[intonation:intonation]] all morning.
33.2.zh: 汤姆帮我们把新词的音发准，整个上午都保持平顺的语调。

33.3.en: Each [[inflection:inflection]] changed the voice, and each [[dialect:dialect]] sounded warm and new.
33.3.zh: 每个屈折变化都让声音不同，每种方言听起来都温暖又新鲜。

33.4.en: Every soft [[utterance:utterance]] gave us the confidence we needed for [[oral:oral]] practice.
33.4.zh: 每一句轻声的话语，都给了我们开口做口语练习的底气。

33.5.en: We learned [[verbal:verbal]] tales and clapped for each new [[syllable:syllable]] with happy hands.
33.5.zh: 我们学口口相传的故事，每学到新音节就开心地拍手。

34.0.en: Each small [[phoneme:phoneme]] matched a bright [[vowel:vowel]] on the whiteboard.
34.0.zh: 每个小音素，都对上了白板上一个醒目的元音。

34.1.en: We wrote each [[consonant:consonant]] neatly beside the tall [[alphabet:alphabet]] chart.
34.1.zh: 我们把每个辅音工整地写在高高的字母表旁。

34.2.en: An old [[logogram:logogram]] smiled beside our growing wall of [[vocabulary:vocabulary]].
34.2.zh: 一个古老的表意字，笑眯眯地守在我们越贴越长的词汇墙边。

34.3.en: Our thick [[dictionary:dictionary]] explained each new [[idiom:idiom]] in simple, clear notes.
34.3.zh: 我们那本厚厚的词典，用简单明白的注解解释每个新习语。

34.4.en: We read each short [[phrase:phrase]] aloud and linked every [[clause:clause]] with care.
34.4.zh: 我们大声读每个短语，又细心地把每个从句连好。

34.5.en: Every [[expression:expression]] of that kind showed the past [[tense:tense]] in a simple, bright way.
34.5.zh: 凡是这一类表达，都用简单醒目的方式标出过去时态。

35.0.en: We added a red [[prefix:prefix]] and a blue [[suffix:suffix]] to make new words.
35.0.zh: 我们给词加上红色前缀和蓝色后缀，造出新词。

35.1.en: Each short [[abbreviation:abbreviation]] matched a simple [[synonym:synonym]] on the [[list:list]].
35.1.zh: 每个简短的缩写，都能在清单上找到一个简单的同义词。

35.2.en: We found one soft [[antonym:antonym]] for each new [[noun:noun]] in the [[tale:tale]].
35.2.zh: 我们给故事里每个新名词，都配了一个语气柔和的反义词。

35.3.en: One [[singular:singular]] apple sat beside two [[round:round]] [[plural:plural]] pears on the table.
35.3.zh: 桌上一个单数的苹果，旁边是两个圆圆的复数梨。

35.4.en: Each [[pronoun:pronoun]] replaced a name, and each [[adjective:adjective]] made it brighter.
35.4.zh: 每个代词替换一个名字，每个形容词让它更鲜活。

35.5.en: We placed one short [[adverb:adverb]] beside each long [[preposition:preposition]] and underlined them both.
35.5.zh: 我们把一个短短的副词放在长长的介词旁边，再把两个都画上下划线。

paraZh.24: 计划不同友情相同，多元碰撞出进步。
paraZh.25: 招新日调查问卷齐上，心愿一一实现。
paraZh.26: 表扬感激交织，新老成员共享成果。
paraZh.27: 周一文明课开讲，历史故事引人入胜。
paraZh.28: 小镇待人热忱，人人守护文化遗产。
paraZh.29: 周二逛博物馆，陶器礼仪两相宜。
paraZh.30: 教堂古寺与红塔，帝国往事声声入耳。
paraZh.31: 年表上帝王将相的故事抚慰乡愁。
paraZh.32: 趣闻解颐小店兴旺，挫折亦是课堂。
paraZh.33: 周三语言角练发音辨方言。
paraZh.34: 音素元音上白板，词典讲透习语。
paraZh.35: 前缀后缀造新词，词性配对乐趣多。
